stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model available under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and features native support for DFlash and image input via Ollama's MLX engine.

stories.title: SpaceX declares Starship ready for orbit, sets launch date next week
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: SpaceX has announced that its Starship vehicle is prepared for an orbital flight test.
The company has scheduled the next launch for the upcoming week.
Achieving orbit is highlighted as a major, significant milestone for the project.

stories.title: Agility’s new humanoid robot will stop, squat to avoid harming human coworkers
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Agility is developing a new humanoid robot designed for collaborative human workspaces.
The robot incorporates advanced safety features, such as stopping and squatting to prevent harm to coworkers.
This development signals a move toward robots operating outside traditional physical safety cages and barriers.

stories.title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
stories.author: Vasilis Syrgkanis
bullet_points: Introduces 'plan injection,' a novel adversarial attack against Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring systems.
The attack involves injecting seemingly benign but harmful reasoning into an LLM's context to bypass safety monitors.
This research highlights a critical vulnerability in current LLM safety strategies that rely on external reasoning inspection.

stories.title: K-Bench: a clinically calibrated benchmark for evaluating large language models in high-risk mental health conversations
stories.author: Elena Volkova
bullet_points: Introduces K-Bench, a new benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLMs in high-risk mental health scenarios.
The benchmark is clinically calibrated and tests 125 model configurations across 33 base models from 14 providers.
It covers critical, high-stakes topics including suicide, self-harm, domestic violence, and substance misuse.

stories.title: Jev: New frontier model 40-400x cheaper and 20-200x faster
stories.author: albelfio
bullet_points: Introduction of 'Jev,' a new frontier model.
Claimed significant performance improvements: 40-400x cheaper and 20-200x faster.
Represents a potential major breakthrough in AI model efficiency and cost.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown

The associated tags confirm its relevance within the transformer, llama, and safetensors ecosystems.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model optimized for agentic workflows.
The model is designed for running complex, multi-step tasks and tool-calling locally on user hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly improved in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speedup reaches up to 90% when utilized with coding agents, as validated by the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher quality outputs, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The key feature is the ability to run these AI agents locally on the user's own hardware.
It integrates native support with Ollama, facilitating local LLM usage.

stories.title: Meta’s new One subscriptions put a price on social media and AI
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Meta is introducing 'Meta One' subscription bundles to monetize its ecosystem.
These bundles integrate standalone app subscriptions with enhanced AI usage capabilities, tied to the launch of Muse.
The new tiers are available globally for individual users, creators, and businesses, signaling a shift toward paid AI access.

stories.title: Exclusive: Paying for frontier AI models buys 4-month head start at 5x the cost
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Open-source AI models are rapidly closing the capability gap with proprietary, frontier models.
The report suggests that paying for premium, frontier AI models offers a significant, measurable advantage (e.g., a 4-month head start) at a much higher cost.
This highlights a critical industry tension between the accessibility of open models and the performance lead of closed, expensive models.

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Proposes a method to achieve native skill routing within a frozen Large Language Model (LLM) without relying on external retrieval pipelines.
Argues that the necessary routing signal for selecting specialized skills is inherently present within the LLM's forward passes.
Demonstrates that two linear maps are sufficient to extract this internal routing information, bypassing context window limitations.

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: The research proposes a novel method to enable LLM agents to select appropriate 'skills' without relying on context-heavy or external retrieval pipelines.
The core finding is that the routing signal for skill selection is inherently present within the frozen LLM's own forward passes.
The authors demonstrate that only two linear maps are required to effectively 'read' and utilize this native routing signal.

stories.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'Mind2Dialogue,' a method to train language models to be more human-aware.
Addresses the 'supervision gap' where current LLM training lacks data reflecting users' unspoken beliefs and goals.
Suggests the need for models capable of deeper understanding for long-term human-AI collaboration.

stories.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
stories.author: Longbo Huang
bullet_points: Proposes a method to elicit native skill routing directly from a frozen Large Language Model (LLM) without external retrieval mechanisms.
Addresses the limitations of current routing methods (context preloading causing attention dispersion, retrieval pipelines losing agent capability).
Demonstrates that the routing signal is inherently present within the LLM's forward passes, requiring only two linear maps for extraction.

stories.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
stories.author: Yingcheng Wu
bullet_points: Proposes 'Discovery Intelligence' as the next major frontier for Foundation Models.
Shifts focus from solving human-specified problems to actively creating new problems, representations, and knowledge.
Introduces the concept of Discovery Foundation Models (DFMs) to enable this proactive, generative intelligence.

stories.title: Mind2Dialogue: Training Human-Aware Language Models by Simulating User Mental States
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Addresses the 'supervision gap' in training LLMs for long-term human collaboration.
Proposes 'Mind2Dialogue' to build human-aware language models by simulating user mental states.
Highlights the need to move beyond explicit data to incorporate users' unspoken beliefs and goals.

stories.title: We got admin access to Baseten's production GitHub in 25 minutes
stories.author: bearsyankees
bullet_points: A security breach occurred where an attacker gained admin access to Baseten's production GitHub repository.
The compromise was achieved within a short timeframe of 25 minutes.
The incident highlights potential vulnerabilities in development/CI/CD security practices.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI platforms with local, open-source LLM infrastructure.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release introduces performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine, improving functionality on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: This doorbell camera lets a human security guard watch your front door
stories.author: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy
bullet_points: SimpliSafe is launching a new AI-powered Video Doorbell Series 2.
The system integrates AI analysis with live human security agents for proactive threat detection.
The doorbell is priced at $199.99, requiring a subscription to Active Guard for full features.

stories.title: Boston dumps Flock, says it shared data nationwide in violation of contract
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: Boston city government is taking action against Flock for violating its service contract.
The core issue is that Flock enabled 'nationwide lookup' capabilities.
This functionality was explicitly prohibited by the terms of the agreement.

stories.title: Demand for EV chargers is outstripping supply, says ChargePoint report
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Demand for Electric Vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure is currently exceeding available supply.
The report highlights that EV adoption is increasing, even within the US market.
The shortage of chargers poses a potential bottleneck to continued EV growth.

stories.title: Volvo increases the batteries for 2028 XC60 and XC90 plug-in refresh
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: Volvo is upgrading the battery capacity for the 2028 refresh of the XC60 and XC90 plug-in models.
The refreshed vehicles will feature updated infotainment systems.
The new infotainment systems will incorporate Gemini technology.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Addresses the limitation of current LLMs in handling long-horizon, interdependent research problems in math and theoretical CS.
Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a model-agnostic harness designed to manage and allocate inference across complex research paths.
Features mechanisms like an 'alternative strategy exploration' and a 'readiness gate' to guide the proof construction process.

stories.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark: Measuring Agentic Security Analysis at Repository Scale
stories.author: Amin Karbasi
bullet_points: Introduces the Vulnerability Localization Benchmark (VLoc Bench) to address a gap in current AI security evaluations.
Focuses on 'vulnerability localization'—identifying the specific code files related to a weakness—rather than just detection or repair.
Addresses the growing trend of language-model agents operating over entire software repositories.

stories.title: SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection
stories.author: Tao Yu
bullet_points: Introduces SlipSense, a multimodal framework designed for low-latency and generalized slip detection in dexterous manipulation.
Utilizes a compact sensor (TacV5) combining a $32 	imes 32$ piezoresistive array (240 Hz) and a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer (8 kHz).
Addresses limitations in current systems regarding precise detection latency and cross-platform generalization for tactile sensing.

stories.title: Privacy-enhanced federated learning via asynchronous aggregation and local differential perturbation
stories.author: Liesheng Wei
bullet_points: Proposes a privacy-enhanced federated learning framework for secure collaborative training.
Integrates Dynamic Differential Privacy (DDP), Homomorphic Encryption (HE), and Local Differential Privacy (LDP) for data protection.
Utilizes an asynchronous aggregation strategy with version control to support distributed training environments.

stories.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
stories.author: Lidong Bing
bullet_points: Introduces Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a new critic-free method for reinforcement learning.
BPO enhances the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) using verifiable rewards (RLVR).
The method reformulates Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) into a trajectory-level objective, bypassing intermediate state value estimation.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Addresses the unreliability of current language models on long-horizon research problems in math and theoretical CS.
Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a model-agnostic harness designed to manage inference across complex research tasks.
The system uses mechanisms like an 'alternative strategy exploration' and a 'readiness gate' to guide proof construction.

stories.title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
stories.author: Ziming Liu
bullet_points: Introduces the concept of 'Causal Writability' in video models, addressing how models handle physically inconsistent motion.
Proposes that incorrect motion generation might stem from a failure to *use* learned knowledge rather than a failure to *learn* it.
Demonstrates the ability to retroactively control generated video using low-dimensional edits, even when the model initially produces conflicting motion.

stories.title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
stories.author: Shen Yan
bullet_points: The research models Transformer representation evolution as a functional geometry, decomposing updates into parallel and perpendicular components.
Analysis across pretrained models reveals significant parallel components in learned updates beyond the standard residual identity path.
The decomposition method is applied to analyze attention and MLP updates relative to the hidden state, offering new insights into model behavior.

stories.title: Privacy-Aligned Personalized Federated Learning with Compact Adaptation and Variable-Length Gaussian Communication
stories.author: Linqi Song
bullet_points: Addresses a structural misalignment in personalized federated learning when client variations are low-dimensional but updates are high-dimensional.
Proposes a solution by releasing a private client context only once and restricting repeated adaptation to a fixed coefficient space.
Introduces a factorized generator to induce an adaptive optimization geometry that reshapes noisy updates while maintaining privacy.

stories.title: Safe Meta-Reinforcement Learning via Information Space Reachability
stories.author: Navid Azizan
bullet_points: Addresses a critical gap in Meta-Reinforcement Learning (Meta-RL): ensuring safety during adaptation to unseen tasks.
Proposes a novel safe Meta-RL framework that integrates safety considerations directly into the learning process.
Introduces the key concept of reasoning about safety within the 'information space,' which models both physical states and agent beliefs.

stories.title: SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection
stories.author: Tao Yu
bullet_points: Introduces SlipSense, a multimodal tactile learning framework designed for accurate and low-latency slip detection.
Utilizes a compact sensor (TacV5) combining a $32 	imes 32$ piezoresistive array (240 Hz) and a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer (8 kHz).
Addresses key limitations in existing systems, specifically focusing on detection latency and cross-platform generalization in dexterous manipulation.

stories.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
stories.author: Lidong Bing
bullet_points: Introduces Bellman Policy Optimization (BPO), a critic-free reinforcement learning method.
BPO is designed to improve the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) using verifiable rewards (RLVR).
It reformulates Policy Mirror Descent (PMD) for autoregressive generation using Bellman equations, avoiding intermediate state value estimation.

stories.title: Stellar Colosseum: A Many-Agent Harness for Long-Horizon Research in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
stories.author: Vahab Mirrokni
bullet_points: Introduces 'Stellar Colosseum,' a new harness designed to manage long-horizon research problems in math and theoretical computer science.
Addresses the limitation of current language models in maintaining reliability across complex, sequential, and interdependent research steps.
The system uses a model-agnostic approach, incorporating an exploration phase and a 'readiness gate' to guide proof construction.

stories.title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
stories.author: Shen Yan
bullet_points: The research analyzes how Transformer representations evolve using a functional geometry approach.
It decomposes learned updates into parallel and perpendicular components relative to the current direction.
Findings indicate significant parallel components in updates across pretrained models, which are then applied to attention and MLP mechanisms.

stories.title: Verifiable by Construction: Claim-Level Evaluation of Verbatim Citation in Clinical Question Answering
stories.author: Michael Oberst
bullet_points: Addresses a critical limitation in current LLM-based Clinical QA: citations are often too broad for efficient verification.
Proposes a novel approach where responses are 'verifiable by construction' using fine-grained verbatim quotes.
Aims to improve clinical trust and usability by allowing users to instantly verify claims without consulting external documents.

stories.title: HypoEvolve: Genetic Algorithms Enable Multi-Agent LLMs to Discover Scientific Hypotheses
stories.author: Zhen Wang
bullet_points: Introduces 'HypoEvolve,' a framework using genetic algorithms to enhance multi-agent Large Language Models (LLMs) for scientific hypothesis discovery.
The system allows scientific agents to synthesize evidence, critique proposals, and iteratively refine explanations.
The research aims to decouple the impact of agents' inherent scientific capabilities from the effects of their collaborative strategies.

stories.title: Inoculation Midtraining with Learned Neologisms
stories.author: David Demitri Africa
bullet_points: Introduces 'Inoculation Midtraining,' a novel technique to guide LLM behavior during an earlier training phase.
The method aims to shape which properties (desirable vs. undesirable) an LLM generalizes during post-training.
It uses a designated neologism (<quarantine_token>) to teach the model that unsafe behavior belongs to a specific, quarantined context.

stories.title: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite
stories.author: bashtian
bullet_points: Capsule is a new project allowing the packaging of single-file web applications.
It uses Rust and Tauri 2.0 to embed HTML assets and data within a single SQLite file.
The solution addresses the common challenge of saving and sharing data from simple web apps without external hosting.
